package.description: A lightweight, native Git and Subversion desktop client, with a read-only project browser, an English/Chinese interface, and optional AI-written commit messages.

en-US.author: 1lck
en-US.description: A lightweight, native Git and Subversion desktop client, with a read-only project browser, an English/Chinese interface, and optional AI-written commit messages.
en-US.longDescription: Viff is a lightweight native Git desktop client written in Go with the Viva toolkit, without Electron or a WebView. It shows diffs, commit history and changelists, offers a read-only project browser, and switches between an English and a Simplified Chinese interface. Viff drives the Git executable already installed on the system; it does not bundle Git.
en-US.name: Viff
en-US.releaseNotes:
Viff 0.4.5 makes the commit scope explicit, makes long diff lines easier to reach, and groups multiple workspace repositories in the Project panel; the app icon also gets a rounded white plate.
Highlights
This release puts the actual commit scope in the Commit panel, adds a visible bottom scroll bar for long diff lines, and lets the Project panel list and switch every repository in the workspace; Windows also gets the rounded white app plate.
✨ New features
- The Project panel shows a Workspace root when the workspace has several repositories, lists each repository's branch and change summary, and switches to a repository when its row is clicked.
- Side-by-side and unified diffs get a bottom horizontal scroll bar for long lines; both panes share the offset, and the bar stays hidden when nothing overflows.
- The Commit panel offers Stage Selected when checked files are not staged, staging only those checked files while leaving already-staged content untouched.
⚡ Improvements
- The Commit panel always states that a commit includes only staged files, so checking files no longer leaves the commit scope implicit.
- The app icon is now a rounded white plate with transparent corners, regenerated from PNG through ICNS and multi-size ICO for a better fit among Windows icons.
🛠 Fixes
- Checking an unstaged file no longer leaves Commit disabled without an explanation; the panel shows the reason and the Stage Selected action.
- Commit and Push now explains that a remote must be added first when the repository has none.
- Horizontal offsets are clamped again after diff panes are resized or folded.
Upgrade instructions
- Upgrading from v0.4.4: the settings file format is unchanged, so existing settings keep working.
- macOS: choose the Apple Silicon or Intel DMG, quit the old version, open the DMG, and replace Viff.app in Applications.
- Windows: quit the old version and run the x64 installer.
- Windows portable: extract the archive, enter its directory, and run viff.exe without installing.
- Debian/Ubuntu: run sudo apt install ./viff-v0.4.5-linux-amd64.deb.
- Linux portable: extract the archive, enter its directory, and run ./viff after installing the required system libraries.
- Install Git separately on PATH, and check the release guide for Linux dependencies.
Compatibility and known issues
- macOS requires version 13 or later; Linux needs a working graphical session, rendering backend, and the system libraries listed in the release guide.
- The Project panel's multi-repository grouping is navigation and switching only: inactive repositories do not load their file trees, their summaries are cached, and cross-repository commit or push is still unavailable.
- After the icon change, Windows Explorer may keep showing a cached old icon until the app is reinstalled or the icon cache is refreshed.
- The macOS app is ad-hoc signed without Developer ID signing or notarization; the Windows installer is not Authenticode signed, so the system may show a security prompt.
- Remote repositories remain read-only observation, and the in-app editing, conflict acceptance, terminal, and external-opening limits are the same as v0.4.4.
Install only files from the project release page after checking their checksums; verify the source if the operating system blocks them.

zh-CN.description: 轻量、原生的 Git 与 Subversion 桌面客户端，内置只读项目浏览、中英文界面与可选的 AI 提交说明。
zh-CN.longDescription: Viff 是基于 Go 与 Viva 工具包打造的轻量原生 Git 桌面客户端，不使用 Electron 与 WebView。它提供差异对比、提交历史、变更列表和只读的项目浏览器，界面可在英文与简体中文之间切换。Viff 调用系统中已安装的 Git 可执行文件，本身并不内置 Git。
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
Viff 0.4.5 让提交范围更清楚、长行 diff 更容易阅读，并让 Project 面板可以聚合工作区里的多个仓库；应用图标也改成了圆角白底。
重点更新
这一版把“勾选、暂存、提交”的范围直接写在提交面板里，长行 diff 有了可见的底部滚动条，多仓库工作区也能在 Project 面板里总览和切换；Windows 桌面图标同时换成了圆角白底。
✨ 新功能
- Project 面板在工作区包含多个仓库时显示 Workspace 根节点，列出各仓库的分支与改动摘要，点击非活动仓库即可切换。
- 并排与统一 diff 的底部新增横向滚动条，长行可以直接拖动查看，并排视图两栏保持同步，没有超长行时自动隐藏。
- Commit 面板在勾选文件尚未暂存时显示 Stage Selected，点击只暂存这些勾选文件，已暂存但未勾选的内容保持不变。
⚡ 改进
- Commit 面板常驻说明“Commit staged files only”，勾选文件时不再让用户猜测提交范围。
- 应用图标改为带透明四角的圆角白底，并重新生成 PNG、ICNS 与多尺寸 ICO，Windows 桌面和任务栏中的观感更接近系统图标。
🛠 修复
- 勾选未暂存文件后 Commit 不再静默保持禁用而没有解释，面板会显示原因和 Stage Selected 入口。
- 未配置远端时 Commit and Push 会提示需要先添加远端。
- 收起或调整 diff 面板宽度后，横向偏移会重新限制在有效范围内。
升级说明
- 从 v0.4.4 升级：设置文件格式未变，现有配置继续可用。
- macOS：按机型选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 的 DMG，退出旧版后打开 DMG，将 Viff.app 拖入“应用程序”并替换旧版。
- Windows：退出旧版后运行 x64 安装器。
- Windows 便携包：解压后进入新目录执行 viff.exe，不写入安装信息。
- Debian/Ubuntu：执行 sudo apt install ./viff-v0.4.5-linux-amd64.deb。
- Linux 便携包：解压后进入新目录执行 ./viff，并自行安装所需系统库。
- Git 需单独安装并加入 PATH，Linux 系统库要求见发布指南。
兼容性与已知问题
- macOS 要求 13 或更高版本；Linux 需要可用的图形会话、渲染后端和发布指南中列出的系统库。
- Project 面板的多仓库分组只负责导航与切换：非活动仓库不加载文件树，状态来自缓存，仍不提供跨仓库提交或推送。
- 更新图标后，Windows 资源管理器可能继续显示缓存中的旧图标；重新安装或刷新图标缓存后即可看到新图标。
- macOS 应用使用 ad-hoc 签名，未经 Developer ID 签名或公证；Windows 安装器未经 Authenticode 签名，系统可能显示安全提示。
- 远程仓库仍是只读观察模式，应用内编辑、冲突接受、终端与外部打开等限制与 v0.4.4 相同。
仅安装来自项目发布页且已核对校验值的文件；如遇系统拦截，请先确认来源。
